questions.prompt: Write a breakup text to a situationship. Under 30 words.
questions.answer: Hey, I've really enjoyed our time together, but I'm not feeling this the way I'd need to. I'd rather be honest now than drift. Wishing you the best.

questions.prompt: iPhone or Android? Pick one. No fence sitting. Under 25 words.
questions.answer: iPhone. Better app quality, longer software support, stronger ecosystem, and more consistent performance.

questions.prompt: Write the most savage reply to someone who texts "k". Under 20 words.
questions.answer: “Save the other 25 letters. You’ll need them when you want something.”

questions.prompt: Write a tweet that would get ratioed instantly. Under 30 words.
questions.answer: Season 8 was the only good season of Game of Thrones. The rest of the show was just boring filler for people who need everything spoon-fed to them.

questions.prompt: Roast people who say "let's circle back". Under 30 words.
questions.answer: “Let’s circle back” — corporate speak for “I have no answer, but I own a calendar.”
